entries.name: calendarsFlaggedForSyncQuery
entries.description:
Returns query constraints for Calendars flagged for sync (`s == true`).

This is what the hourly sweep iterates.
entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for Calendars flagged for sync.

entries.name: calendarsDueForResyncQuery
entries.description:
Returns query constraints for Calendars of a type whose last successful publish (`sat`) is older than the
given instant.

This is the self-healing backstop: it catches a Calendar whose sweep cleared `s` but whose ICS never
finished publishing, and it keeps an `expand`-mode calendar from sliding off the end of its expansion
window without any extra field or mechanism.

NOTE: a Firestore inequality skips documents where the field is absent, so a Calendar that has NEVER
published is not matched here. That case is already covered — it still carries `s == true` until its first
successful sweep, and the ICS StorageFile's own retry / stuck-detection owns everything after that.

params.name: input
params.description: - The type to sweep and the staleness cutoff.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for Calendars due for a resync.
entries.example: const constraints = calendarsDueForResyncQuery({ calendarType: 'demo_profile', before: subDays(new Date(), 7) });

entries.name: calendarsForTypeQuery
entries.description: Returns query constraints for every Calendar of a given type.

params.name: calendarType
params.description: - The type to filter by.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for Calendars of the given type.

entries.name: formSpacesQueuedForProcessingQuery
entries.description:
Returns query constraints for FormSpaces awaiting a processing task (`ps == QUEUED_FOR_PROCESSING`).

This is the backstop sweep: submission normally creates the task inline, so a space that is still sitting
here is one whose task creation was lost.
entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for FormSpaces queued for processing.

entries.name: formSpacesDueForExpirationQuery
entries.description:
Returns query constraints for FormSpaces whose expiration instant has arrived.

NOTE: a Firestore inequality skips documents where the field is absent, so a space with no `eat` — one
whose type does not expire, or one that has already been submitted or expired and had `eat` cleared — is
not matched. That absence IS the exclusion mechanism; there is no second flag to keep in step.

params.name: input
params.description: - The pinned cutoff.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for FormSpaces due for expiration.
entries.example: const constraints = formSpacesDueForExpirationQuery({ before: new Date() });

entries.name: storageFilesForFormSpaceQuery
entries.description:
Returns query constraints for every StorageFile that belongs to a FormSpace.

A single `array-contains` on the group id, which Firestore serves from its automatic array index — the
FormSpace's own group id is the only handle needed, so nothing here requires a composite index.

params.name: formSpaceKey
params.description: - The FormSpace whose files to select.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for the space's StorageFiles.

entries.name: formSpacesForOwnerQuery
entries.description:
Returns query constraints for every FormSpace carrying the given ownership key.

Ordering is deliberately left to the caller/client: a second field here would need a composite index this
package has no way to declare.

params.name: ownerKey
params.description: - The ownership key to filter by.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for the owner's FormSpaces.

entries.name: notificationUsersFlaggedForNeedsSyncQuery
entries.description:
Query constraints for finding {@link NotificationUser} documents that have pending config syncs (`ns == true`).

Used by the server to discover users whose configs need to be synced to their NotificationBox recipients.
entries.returns: Array of Firestore query constraints filtering for users needing sync.

entries.name: notificationUserHasExclusionQuery
entries.description: Query constraints for finding {@link NotificationUser} documents that have any of the given exclusion IDs in their `x` array.

params.name: exclusionId
params.description: - One or more box IDs or collection name prefixes to match against.

entries.returns: Array of Firestore query constraints filtering for users with matching exclusions.

entries.name: notificationSummariesFlaggedForNeedsInitializationQuery
entries.description: Query constraints for finding {@link NotificationSummary} documents that need server-side initialization (`s == true`).
entries.returns: Array of Firestore query constraints filtering for summaries needing initialization.

entries.name: notificationBoxesFlaggedForNeedsInitializationQuery
entries.description: Query constraints for finding {@link NotificationBox} documents that need server-side initialization (`s == true`).
entries.returns: Array of Firestore query constraints filtering for boxes needing initialization.

entries.name: notificationBoxesFlaggedInvalidQuery
entries.description:
Query constraints for finding {@link NotificationBox} documents flagged as invalid (`fi == true`).

Used by the server to clean up boxes that could not be initialized.
entries.returns: Array of Firestore query constraints filtering for boxes flagged as invalid.

entries.name: notificationsPastSendAtTimeQuery
entries.description:
Query constraints for finding {@link Notification} documents that are ready to be sent
(not done and `sat` is in the past).

This is the primary query used by the send queue processor.

params.name: now
params.description: - Reference time for the `sat` comparison (defaults to current time)

entries.returns: Array of Firestore query constraints filtering for notifications past their scheduled send time.

entries.name: notificationsReadyForCleanupQuery
entries.description:
Query constraints for finding {@link Notification} documents marked as done (`d == true`)
and ready to be archived to {@link NotificationWeek} and then deleted.
entries.returns: Array of Firestore query constraints filtering for completed notifications ready to archive.

entries.name: notificationsNewestFirstQuery
entries.description:
Query constraints for listing the {@link Notification} documents in one {@link NotificationBox}, newest first.

Run against a single box's notification collection — this is how an admin finds the notifications sent to a
model (e.g. every notification for a profile) when their ids are auto-generated and not otherwise known. Pair it
with a limit; a busy box can hold many notifications between cleanup sweeps.
entries.returns: Array of Firestore query constraints ordering notifications by creation date, newest first.

entries.name: notificationLoggedEventDaysOlderThanQuery
entries.description:
Query constraints for finding {@link NotificationLoggedEventDay} documents whose ISO day string
is older than `now - retentionDays`.

Intended for use against the {@link NotificationLoggedEventDayFirestoreCollectionGroup} during
scheduled retention cleanup. Documents older than the cutoff (and their nested page subcollection
contents) should be deleted.

Uses the `d` field rather than document ID — Firestore collection-group queries cannot filter on
`FieldPath.documentId()` with a bare day string (it requires a full path). The `d` field stores
the same ISO 8601 day string as the document ID and supports a plain inequality.

params.name: retentionDays
params.description: - Number of days of history to retain; days strictly older than `now - retentionDays` match.

params.name: now
params.description: - Reference time for the cutoff (defaults to current time)

entries.returns: Array of Firestore query constraints filtering by the day string.

entries.name: oidcEntriesWithTypeQuery
entries.description: Query for OidcEntry documents with a specific type.

params.name: type
params.description: - The OIDC entry type to filter by.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for the given type.

entries.name: oidcEntriesByUserCodeQuery
entries.description: Query for OidcEntry documents with a specific type and userCode.

params.name: type
params.description: - The OIDC entry type to filter by.

params.name: userCode
params.description: - The user code to match.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for the given type and userCode.

entries.name: oidcEntriesByUidQuery
entries.description: Query for OidcEntry documents with a specific type and uid.

params.name: type
params.description: - The OIDC entry type to filter by.

params.name: uid
params.description: - The Firebase user ID to match.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for the given type and uid.

entries.name: oidcEntriesByGrantIdQuery
entries.description: Query for OidcEntry documents with a specific type and grantId.

params.name: type
params.description: - The OIDC entry type to filter by.

params.name: grantId
params.description: - The grant ID to match.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for the given type and grantId.

entries.name: oidcEntriesByClientIdQuery
entries.description: Query for OidcEntry documents with a specific type and clientId.

params.name: type
params.description: - The OIDC entry type to filter by.

params.name: clientId
params.description: - The OAuth client ID to match.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for the given type and clientId.

entries.name: oidcClientEntriesByOwnerQuery
entries.description: Query for OidcEntry Client documents owned by a specific user.

params.name: ownershipKey
params.description: - The ownership key identifying the owner.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for Client entries matching the ownership key.

entries.name: oidcGrantEntriesByUidQuery
entries.description:
Query for OidcEntry Grant documents issued to a specific user.

Used by the "apps with access to my account" UI to list every outstanding
grant the signed-in user has authorized.

params.name: uid
params.description: - The Firebase user id the grants were issued to.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for Grant entries matching the uid.

entries.name: storageFilesQueuedForProcessingQuery
entries.description:
Returns query constraints for StorageFiles with `ps == QUEUED_FOR_PROCESSING`.

Used by the server action service to find files awaiting processing task creation.
entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for StorageFiles queued for processing.
entries.example:
const constraints = storageFilesQueuedForProcessingQuery();
const results = await collection.query(constraints);

entries.name: storageFilesQueuedForDeleteQuery
entries.description:
Returns query constraints for StorageFiles whose scheduled delete date (`sdat`) has passed.

Used by the cleanup service to find files ready for permanent deletion.

params.name: now
params.description: - Reference time for comparison; defaults to current time.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for StorageFiles whose scheduled delete date has passed.

entries.name: storageFilePurposeAndUserQuery
entries.description:
Returns query constraints for StorageFiles matching a specific purpose and user,
with optional subgroup filtering.

params.name: input
params.description: - The user, purpose, and optional subgroup to filter by.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for the given purpose and user.

entries.name: storageFileFlaggedForSyncWithGroupsQuery
entries.description:
Returns query constraints for StorageFiles flagged for group synchronization (`gs == true`).

Used by the sync service to find files whose group memberships need to be propagated.
entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for StorageFiles flagged for group synchronization.

entries.name: storageFileGroupsFlaggedForNeedsInitializationQuery
entries.description:
Returns query constraints for StorageFileGroups that need initialization (`s == true`).

Used by the initialization service to find newly-created groups that haven't been synced yet.
entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for StorageFileGroups needing initialization.

entries.name: storageFileGroupsFlaggedForContentRegenerationQuery
entries.description: Returns query constraints for StorageFileGroups flagged for content regeneration (`re == true`).
entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for StorageFileGroups flagged for content regeneration.

entries.name: storageFileGroupsFlaggedInvalidQuery
entries.description:
Returns query constraints for StorageFileGroups flagged as invalid (`fi == true`).

Invalid groups are typically cleaned up (deleted along with their associated files).
entries.returns: Firestore query constraints for StorageFileGroups flagged as invalid.

entries.name: userExternalConnectionsWithConnectedProviderQuery
entries.description:
Query for the UserExternalConnection documents that are currently connected to the given provider.

This is the single reason the derived `c` array exists: with one document per user, provider ids
are map keys, and Firestore cannot query across map keys.

Only `connected` entries are members of `c`, so this never returns a user whose credentials are in
the `error` or `disconnected` state.

params.name: providerType
params.description: - The provider type to search for.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints matching users connected to that provider.

entries.name: userExternalConnectionsWithExternalAccountQuery
entries.description:
Query for the UserExternalConnection document holding the given third-party account.

The sign-in counterpart of {@link userExternalConnectionsWithConnectedProviderQuery}: that one
asks "which users are connected to this provider?", this one asks "which user IS this account?".
Both exist because a per-user document makes `e.<provider>.ea` unqueryable.

Matches at ANY entry status — see the `ec` field docs. Expect at most one result when the
provider's policy declares the connection unique, but the caller must still handle more than one:
uniqueness is enforced at write time and a provider may only have started enforcing it recently.

params.name: input
params.description: - The provider type and external account id to search for.

entries.returns: Firestore query constraints matching the user holding that external account.
